Squeeze over lemon and spear onto toothpicks.Yule Ball smoked salmon blinisThe Yule Ball in the Great HallHow to make itAs written, serves 4Warm buckwheat blinis topped with crème fraîche, smoked salmon, dill, lemon zest and a little salmon roe, laid out on silver trays.Whisk 100g buckwheat flour, 50g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt with 200ml milk and 1 egg into a thick batter.Cook teaspoons in a buttered pan for 1 minute a side to make about 30 blinis.Cool slightly.Top each with a little crème fraîche, a curl of smoked salmon, a sprig of dill, lemon zest and a few beads of salmon roe.MainsYule Ball roastRib roast with roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and honey glazed carrotsHow to make it2kg beef rib roast1kg potatoes, peeled and halved3 eggs150g plain flour300ml milk4 carrots, cut in batons2 tbsp honey200ml beef stock1 tbsp balsamic vinegar2 tbsp olive oilsalt and pepper, to tasteHeat the oven to 220°C. Season the beef and roast for the first stage.Drop the oven to 160°C and roast the beef until 52°C in the middle.Rest the beef under foil.Roast the potatoes in oil alongside the beef.Whisk the eggs, flour and milk and bake Yorkshires in hot oiled tins at 220°C.Glaze the carrots with honey and roast.Make gravy by simmering the beef stock and balsamic vinegar with the pan juices.French school bouillabaisse with rouilleThe visiting French schoolHow to make itAs written, serves 4Snapper, mussels and prawns simmered in a saffron, fennel and tomato broth, with toasted baguette and a garlicky red rouille to stir through.Soften 1 onion, 1 fennel bulb and 4 garlic cloves in olive oil.Add a pinch of saffron, 1 strip orange zest, 1 tin crushed tomatoes and 1.2 litres fish stock and simmer 20 minutes.Add 600g snapper chunks for 3 minutes, then 500g mussels and 8 green prawns for 4 minutes until opened.Blend 1 roasted capsicum, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp breadcrumbs, a pinch of chilli and 80ml olive oil for rouille.Serve with toasted baguette.SweetsIce palace pavlovaCrisp meringue with a soft centre, topped with whipped creamHow to make it4 egg whites220g caster sugar1 tsp cornflour300ml thickened cream, whipped50g white chocolate, shaved250g mixed berries1 tbsp icing sugarHeat the oven to 120°C. Whip the egg whites to soft peaks, add the sugar gradually until glossy, then fold in the cornflour.Shape on baking paper and bake for 90 minutes.Turn off the oven and cool the pavlova inside.Top with whipped cream, white chocolate and berries, dusted with icing sugar.DrinksMulled apple punchApple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and star anise, served warmHow to make it1.5 L cloudy apple juice2 cinnamon sticks6 whole cloves1 orange, peel only2 star anisesSimmer the apple juice with the cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and star anise.Strain and serve warm in mugs.Sparkling pomegranate and rosewater fizzFleur's toast with the Beauxbatons girls.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
